verdict.rationale: Webhooks are registrable outbound HTTP callbacks sent by a hosted service or API, which is a different product role from a local desktop operating system like macOS. Nothing in the evidence shows macOS ships webhook registration. Safari Notify Me's user-facing page-change alerts are an adjacent notification feature, not programmatic HTTP callbacks, so they do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
